decision: Fixed implementation passes bounded shape-fit and single-slot race checks.

findings.case: single-slot equip while onePiece dependency hash awaited
findings.cause: equip captured visible ids before awaited shape dependency validation, then committed stale ids
findings.fix: re-read current visible ids after await and synchronously revalidate all final dependencies before commit

actual GLB weight normalization and fit/shape/author SHA identities match
attr references, attribute version/data.version and post-await checks present in fixed equipment.js
